tasks.title: Deterministic local pack install and pinned evidence retrieval
acceptance: Install a validated fictional data-only pack only when trusted local policy authorizes it.
Resolve an explicit identifier and edition to an immutable package digest.
Retrieve an exact clause and its required governing note with source hashes and stable locations.
Repeat the workflow while all network socket creation is denied.
Install a second edition and prove the first package pin returns unchanged evidence.
Reject tampered, untracked, executable, unauthorized, ambiguous, and misleadingly under-budget inputs with typed errors.

tasks.title: Complete deterministic read operations and dependency-sensitive edition comparison
acceptance: Assemble multiple exact clauses and required dependencies without duplicate evidence.
Enumerate every explicitly classified obligation in a pinned scope with stable, signed, expiring continuations.
Bind continuations to package, scope, principal, and current policy fingerprint.
Compare two editions conservatively by exact record identity and surface dependency-context impacts.
Refuse to truncate an atomic packet under a byte budget.
Run every read operation with networking denied and migrate schema version 1 without inventing legacy classifications.

tasks.title: Local read-only MCP adapter with trusted principal binding
acceptance: Expose only the query contract's declared read operations over local stdio MCP with no administrative tools.
Bind the principal from trusted server startup configuration and omit it from every tool schema.
Preserve successful result envelopes and typed domain-error envelopes across the MCP boundary.
Disable SDK telemetry even when a host process configures an exporter.
Prove in-memory transport parity with networking denied and prove a real stdio subprocess round trip.

tasks.title: Official-source local corpus manifest and offline verification
acceptance: Track stable official DLA ASSIST metadata and exact local filenames, byte counts, and SHA-256 digests for the three MIL format-authority seed documents.
Keep downloaded PDFs in ignored local state and make no repository-redistribution claim.
Verify the closed local source set, PDF signatures, byte counts, and digests without network access.
Reject tampering, path traversal, unknown catalog fields, unexpected directory content, and non-PDF bytes with typed errors.
Keep source acquisition administrative and outside every query operation.

tasks.title: Deterministic PDF text-layer compiler and MIL-STD-810H pack
acceptance: Acquire and catalog the official active MIL-STD-810 Revision H Change 1 incorporated edition from DLA ASSIST.
Compile a verified PDF deterministically into an installable data-only pack while preserving the original PDF bytes and a separately hashed extracted-text sidecar.
Produce one source-linked page record for every extractable physical page without silently invoking OCR or classifying obligations.
Record page-level extraction dimensions and explicit unresolved fidelity for visual layout, tables, figures, clause boundaries, and obligations.
Reject encrypted PDFs, catalog/page mismatches, unsafe source records, and existing output directories with typed errors.
Install, resolve, search, and retrieve the full 1,107-page MIL-STD-810H pack offline with raw-PDF and extracted-text integrity rechecked.

tasks.title: Coverage propagation and discovery-to-evidence closure
acceptance: Propagate the installed pack's declared corpus, edition, extraction, dependency, traversal, and budget coverage into every retrieval packet.
Expose source interpretation, required-dependency identification and retrieval, database traversal, and response fit as separate machine-readable dimensions.
Carry declared source and dependency coverage into search results without duplicating it for every hit.
Keep exact selection/dependency completion distinct from corpus and extraction completeness.
Make clause, note, and compiled-page search hits directly retrievable through the existing pinned read operation.
Require unique record references within an edition so discovery selectors are deterministic.
Avoid duplicate file reads when legacy source bytes are also the evidence text.

tasks.title: Source-spanned structural compilation with stable logical identity
acceptance: Compile an explicitly reviewed section of a verified PDF into a document tree with closed node kinds and typed relationships.
Keep logical identity, content digest, and physical source location separate so content or pagination changes do not silently redefine identity.
Bind every node and relationship to exact text-layer spans using the original PDF digest, page-text digest, physical page, half-open UTF-8 byte offsets, and quote digest.
Preserve unresolved, ambiguous, and out-of-scope relationships and unsupported regions without inventing targets or completeness.
Keep agent review, human review, automated validation, and normative source evidence separate.
Install and retrieve the structural pack through the existing authorization boundary with required governing relationships expanded.
Reject changed page text, invalid UTF-8 boundaries, unresolved parents or required targets, graph cycles, and unreviewed or mismatched source identities.

tasks.title: Compact progressively expandable evidence responses
acceptance: Keep detailed JSON as the unchanged default and expose compact_evidence_v1 as an opt-in profile on get_clause and build_context through CLI and MCP.

Return deterministic packet-local references, unique evidence records, and deduplicated source and derivation dictionaries while preserving canonical record IDs, exact text, citations, and completeness dimensions.
Preserve typed response envelopes and caller-independent authorization, and reauthorize each compact packet after source integrity checks.
Measure complete compact UTF-8 JSON bytes; expose token measurement as unavailable unless a configured local tokenizer exists.
Verify default compatibility, MCP schema parity, exact evidence preservation, deterministic output, budget refusal, invalid profiles, and tampered-source rejection.

tasks.title: Batched authorization-safe caches and scoped discovery
acceptance: Read multi-root required-evidence closures in one connection with deterministic legacy-compatible ordering and deduplicated relationships.
Read and hash each shared source or text sidecar once per request while re-reading it on later requests so warmed caches cannot hide tampering.
Cache only versioned closure and lexical-search projections in bounded checksum-verified envelopes; never cache an authorization allow decision or source verification result.

Key search caches by corpus generation, authorization generation, principal visibility fingerprint, filters, limit, and ranker version, and invalidate results across install, grant, and revocation changes.
Reauthorize before cache lookup and immediately before returning package-pinned evidence or scoped search results.
Expose exact package and clause-scope filters through the library, CLI, MCP, and machine contracts without network, model, synonym, or broadening fallback.
Verify cache corruption misses safely, cross-principal results remain isolated, revocation changes results immediately, and batched/cached paths preserve evidence and completeness.

tasks.title: Integrity-complete optimized retrieval and replayable discovery
acceptance: Verify every returned structural node span and relationship evidence span against its declared source or text sidecar, exact half-open UTF-8 byte range, and quote digest before returning evidence.
Read and hash each distinct source artifact once and decode each distinct UTF-8 text artifact once per request without allowing a warmed request or process cache to hide later tampering.
Assemble one obligation page through a batched evidence graph while preserving the established detailed response shape, ordering, completeness, cursor, and authorization behavior.
Reuse request-local verification state across edition-diff payloads without sharing integrity results across requests.
Return the caller's exact search query and filters, keep unpinned filters unpinned, and expose directly replayable exact record selectors through the library, CLI, MCP, and contracts.
Measure the optimized paths against the pre-change audit fixtures and real local pack, and accept only output-compatible speedups with source-integrity negative cases.

tasks.title: Accurate concise standards surfacing
acceptance: Reject any structural pack whose resolved required relationships and retrieval dependencies are not the same typed target edges.

Compile page records with exact half-open UTF-8 offsets into the preserved text sidecar and verify those slices without repeated whole-sidecar quote searches, while retaining compatibility for previously installed packs.
Reject lexical queries beyond the supported term limit instead of silently discarding later constraints, and return source-linked matched snippets and structural ancestry where available.

Expose a versioned concise evidence response through the library, CLI, MCP, and contracts that preserves exact normative text, citations, governing relationships, coverage, authorization, and expandable provenance while reducing measured model-visible tokens on representative packets.
Measure fixture, full-page, and reviewed-structure paths for packet equality of evidence, tamper rejection, latency, bytes, and configured local tokenizer counts.
Keep exact package pins authoritative when multiple representations exist for one edition and report representation ambiguity explicitly rather than selecting one silently.

tasks.title: Lossless physical and response-path compression
acceptance: Preserve distinct ambiguous structural relationships in concise packets without changing resolved-edge deduplication or exact evidence.
Calculate packet byte budgets with one full serialization while returning byte-identical packets and exact refusal thresholds.
Remove duplicate page text from newly compiled portable page records and reconstruct it only from inventoried, hash-verified UTF-8 byte ranges while retaining records 0.1 compatibility.
Remove the FTS content shadow copy through a rebuildable external-content index with a deterministic migration and unchanged authorized search results.

Forbid mutable hard-link or symbolic-link sharing between installed package paths; retain independent copies unless copy-on-write block cloning is explicitly supported and verified on the target filesystem.
Offer a trusted startup-selected MCP response mode that avoids duplicate wire payloads while retaining the backward-compatible default.
Measure storage bytes, packet equality, query latency, archive size, and negative integrity behavior on representative fixture and real-document paths.

tasks.title: Manifest-driven full local MIL-STD corpus compilation and installation
acceptance: Verify the complete local DLA acquisition manifest and compile every record with at least one downloaded current component into one deterministic page-text pack and compressed transport without network access.

Preserve the exact ordered current-component composition, source digests, component dates, and distribution statements; compile only Distribution Statement A components and declare mixed public and restricted compositions partial rather than silently treating public bytes as the complete edition.
Use deterministic publisher-scoped family, edition, pack, record, and page-selector identities that remain stable across restart and never merge unrelated DLA records or components.

Checkpoint a restartable corpus index, validate every reused archive against the complete current composition and compiler provenance before skipping it, and report every extraction failure without claiming the corpus complete.

Install every compiled pack only under an explicit trusted local policy, revoke obsolete grants for prior generated versions of the same corpus pack identities, then resolve, search, and retrieve exact source-verified evidence from the populated local store.
Keep physical-page text unreviewed and expose no claim of OCR, visual, table, figure, clause-boundary, obligation, applicability, or human-approval completeness.

tasks.title: Deterministic derived-outline compilation from verified page evidence
acceptance: Compile an installed or portable page-text pack into a separate deterministic derived-structure pack without networking, model calls, source mutation, or human-review claims.

Recognize bounded numeric clauses, appendices, method headings, list items, notes, and table or figure captions while preserving every derived node as an exact UTF-8 source span over inventoried page evidence.
Assign stable edition-scoped logical identities independently from content hashes and retain component and method context so repeated numbering cannot silently merge unrelated nodes.
Keep every automated node unclassified and automated_unreviewed, expose unmatched and ambiguous text as unsupported-region records, and never enumerate derived candidates as confirmed obligations.

Preserve the base package digest and coverage in an inventoried derivation report, install under explicit local policy, resolve the derived_structure representation, and retrieve exact source-verified evidence.
Qualify the compiler on synthetic negative cases and a real full-document MIL-STD pack, reporting observed detection and unsupported-region coverage without claiming semantic correctness.

tasks.title: Copy-paste local onboarding and model-facing MIL-STD reading guidance
acceptance: Provide one copy-paste PowerShell workflow from isolated installation through derived-outline compilation, explicit local authorization, installation, resolution, search, exact retrieval, and MCP startup.

Create an exact one-pack local policy only through an explicit administrative command that requires the operator to name the principal and expected content class; never infer authority from pack rights alone.

Deliver a concise MIL-STD reading workflow to MCP clients during initialization, covering exact edition and representation selection, immutable package pins, discovery versus evidence, governing context, tailoring and applicability boundaries, notices, and honest completeness.
Make every MCP tool description state its operation-specific interpretation boundary, including that derived structure is unreviewed and zero classified obligations is not proof of zero requirements.
Keep the MCP surface read-only, offline, principal-bound, and limited to the query contract's declared operations.
Verify policy-writer negative cases, actual client-visible instructions and descriptions, contract parity, copy-paste command syntax, and the complete local test suite.

tasks.title: Post-build documentation and code-comment scrub
acceptance: Keep the root README current as the primary installation and usage guide, with working links to retained governance, architecture, security, validation, and model-reading material.
Remove unreferenced dated audits and duplicated agent workflow documentation whose current outcomes are retained in the validation report and active project instructions.
Condense required project orientation and brand documentation without removing active migration, rights, security, or evidence-boundary guidance.
Update stale decision and security wording to the observed TASK-015 implementation without converting proposals into approval claims.
Remove redundant implementation comments and duplicate MCP function docstrings while retaining comments that explain security, integrity, compatibility, transactional, or algorithmic invariants.
Verify retained Markdown links, stale documentation references, contract parsing, compilation, and the complete local test suite.

tasks.title: Dependency-complete CI and executable response contracts
acceptance: Install the MCP, compiler, and contract-validation profiles in every supported CI matrix job and fail on inconsistent installed dependencies.
Check every declared JSON Schema against its selected metaschema and validate the repository's concrete contract documents against their schemas.

Validate actual success packets for all declared read operations, first and final continuation pages, compact and concise evidence profiles, and typed error envelopes against operation-specific contracts.
Prove malformed packets fail validation rather than relying only on positive fixtures.
Build the wheel in a clean temporary directory, install it outside the checkout, and run a dependency-free core read smoke test without PYTHONPATH source leakage.

tasks.title: Explicit prepared-distribution source baseline
acceptance: Replace broad corpus-completeness language with the exact active, current-component, Distribution Statement A baseline and identify excluded document classes, historical editions, restricted bytes, and unsupported semantic coverage.

Inventory the scope statement inside the deterministic release bundle and point the human content notice to the actual bundled provenance paths.
Reject mismatched acquisition snapshots, missing required scope fields, inconsistent counts, and any scope statement that upgrades automated or absent semantic review.

acceptance: Build the core wheel twice from copied packaging inputs with a fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and pinned backend, and reject any byte difference, timestamp drift, or unexpected generator.
Install the verified wheel without extras in a fresh environment outside the checkout and complete a dependency-free core read smoke with source-path leakage disabled.

Optionally retain that exact verified wheel plus schema-validated provenance containing its source-file inventory, tool identity, digest, size, version, epoch, and two-build result without overwriting existing outputs.
Require the prepared-distribution builder to validate the wheel, its provenance, and every inventoried source hash, then preserve and bind the provenance in the final bundle manifest.
Prove identical prepared inputs produce byte-identical final ZIPs and reject changed source inputs, malformed provenance, or an unlisted final archive member.

tasks.title: Lossless multi-span reviewed logical clauses
acceptance: Accept versioned reviewed structural annotations containing up to 64 ordered, non-overlapping source spans while preserving the one-span 0.1 contract.
Assemble a logical node only by joining its exact ordered UTF-8 source fragments with one declared newline and reject any digest, ordering, overlap, or reconstruction mismatch.
Preserve every physical-page span plus an inventoried exact assembled sidecar without presenting that sidecar as a replacement for source evidence.
Return the whole multi-page logical clause in one get_clause record together with its required governing context and reverify every fragment on each read.
Reject retrieval after tampering with any contributing page sidecar and retain existing single-span behavior.

tasks.title: Bounded reviewed semantic requirement packet
acceptance: Accept only versioned reviewed semantic decompositions bound to the node's exact source spans, with closed roles for normativity, subject, action, modality, polarity, conditions, exceptions, source qualifiers, raw quantities, and unresolved issues.

Emit a query-visible content-bound review event containing reviewer identity and type, timestamp, method, tool provenance, unresolved issues, and an attestation that extraction review is not project applicability or approval.

Reject invented semantic text, invalid span references, missing agent tool provenance, semantic or structural kind mismatches, changed reviewed-content digests, and any semantic claim that decides project applicability.
Retrieve one synthetic reviewed multi-page obligation with its required governing note and definition plus a transitive table-footnote, table-row, and table-header chain.
Keep this acceptance bounded to the synthetic reviewed packet; do not claim document-wide semantic segmentation, obligation classification, applicability, compliance, or human approval.

tasks.title: Explicit lexical discovery modes
acceptance: Expose exact_phrase, all_terms, and any_terms through the core, CLI, MCP, and versioned machine contracts while preserving all_terms when the option is omitted.
Parse at most 32 bounded lexical chunks, quote every chunk, and compile only the selected mode so caller quotes, operators, wildcards, and parentheses never become raw FTS syntax.
Return the selected mode, normalized query, and parsed chunks with the existing source citation, snippet, ancestry, coverage, authorization, package, scope, and exact evidence-selector fields.
Separate cache entries by mode even when a one-chunk query compiles to the same FTS expression; retain authorization generations and reauthorization behavior.
Reject unknown or non-text modes with a typed core error, schema-reject an undeclared returned mode, and validate actual packets for all three modes.
Keep document-level grouping, controlled vocabulary expansion, and optional semantic discovery outside this bounded slice.

tasks.title: Conservative revision candidates and side-qualified transitive impacts
acceptance: Keep exact record IDs as the sole authority for added, removed, modified, moved, and unchanged classifications and for raw dependency-edge deltas.

Report a unique unmatched kind and clause-reference pair only as a review-required candidate with before and after record IDs and text digests; never use it to rewrite authoritative changes, dependency edges, or impact paths.
Classify a source-only location change as moved while treating substantive record, derivation, or structural meaning changes as modified, and expose both before and after evidence for either case.
Traverse required dependencies independently in the before and after package graphs and return deterministic side-qualified paths to each distinct changed-record or edge-delta cause.
Reject the mixed-graph failure mode where an edge from one edition and an edge from the other could fabricate a transitive path that existed in neither package.

Version the changed detailed response and MCP output contract while leaving reviewed alignment artifacts, split and merge mappings, fuzzy equivalence, and semantic change classification outside this bounded slice.

tasks.title: Synthetic benchmark contracts and deterministic qualification runner
acceptance: Validate a versioned benchmark-suite contract whose reviewed content is bound by digest to exact local package identities, editions, representations, cases, critical facts, completeness expectations, and forbidden claims.

Run the tracked fictional packs offline through exact resolution, all three lexical modes, package-pinned context retrieval, outside-baseline discovery, and edition comparison while preserving raw per-case results and failures.

Emit a schema-valid benchmark-run artifact with suite digest, runner and environment identity, service-cache-cold and immediate-warm samples, exact metric numerators and denominators, response bytes, and content digest.

Require zero wrong-edition results, citation mismatches, lost critical facts or required context, and false-completeness outcomes for the synthetic suite; any failed case must make the gate fail without being omitted from the run artifact.

Reject suite digest mismatch, synthetic suites labeled as real-quality evidence, missing source pins or review provenance, malformed metric denominators, omitted case results, and mixed synthetic and real-quality aggregation.

Label this result synthetic_contract_qualification only; keep real-document discovery accuracy, semantic fidelity, tokenizer-normalized efficiency, resource limits, and engineer time saved explicitly not measured until a separately authorized human-reviewed suite exists.

tasks.title: Non-mutating portable readiness doctor
acceptance: Expose a cross-platform doctor command and closed versioned response contract covering supported Python, SQLite FTS5, database schema, object-store paths, installed packages, active grants, trusted-policy alignment, integrity coverage, and optional MCP availability.

Open existing state read-only and never create directories, initialize or migrate a database, change grants, install packs, fetch network resources, or invoke a model; an uninitialized path must remain byte-for-byte absent after diagnosis.

Return every check with required or advisory severity, pass, fail, or not_checked status, stable code, bounded details, and an overall ready or not_ready result instead of stopping at the first failure.

Keep quick structural inspection distinct from full package-integrity validation and report exact validated and total package counts so partial integrity coverage cannot be mistaken for complete validation.

When a trusted policy is supplied, validate it independently, bind the selected principal explicitly, and detect missing grants, revoked grants, policy-fingerprint drift, missing object packages, path escape, symlinks, and package-digest mismatch.
Return exit zero only for ready state and a distinct documented nonzero exit for completed not-ready diagnosis; retain existing typed domain and internal failure behavior.

Cover initialized and uninitialized stores, healthy quick and full checks, tampered or missing objects, unsupported schema, policy drift, optional versus required MCP, no-network execution, and schema validation of actual reports.

tasks.title: Deterministic cross-platform synthetic starter bundle
acceptance: Build a deterministic synthetic-only starter ZIP containing the two exact fictional packs, their exact trusted policy, a twice-built verified core wheel and its source provenance, a closed bundle manifest, and stdlib-only setup and launcher scripts that work on Windows and POSIX.

Validate the wheel and provenance against the current inventoried source, validate and archive both packs, require an exact policy allowlist and synthetic content class, inventory every bundled byte, reject unsafe or duplicate paths and symbolic links, reopen nested packs, and require two independent builds to be byte-identical.

Before any setup write, revalidate the complete extracted bundle; create an isolated environment without network dependency resolution, install only the bundled wheel and exact packs, and run full doctor plus lexical-discovery and exact-context smokes against the installed state.

Write a closed receipt bound to the manifest, wheel, policy, and package digests; on later setup runs always revalidate the bundle, receipt, full doctor, and evidence smokes, and never skip work solely because a marker file exists.

Fail closed on tampered or extra files, traversal, symlinks, duplicate archive members, wrong wheel or policy identity, stale receipts, unowned existing state, and malformed or interrupted setup state; recover only an explicitly marked setup-owned partial state.
Exercise the actual extracted bundle in the existing Windows and Linux, Python 3.11 and 3.12 CI matrix without checkout PYTHONPATH, and keep the dependency-free core-wheel smoke separate.

Document the starter as fictional contract behavior for learning and integration only, not real-document discovery, semantic quality, applicability, compliance, approval, or a replacement for the prepared public corpus.

tasks.title: Source-first evidence reader and neutral engineering handoff
acceptance: Add one explicit administrative export command that calls the existing package-pinned detailed get-clause path with an exact clause or record selector and trusted principal; do not add a seventh query or MCP operation.

Define closed candidate-draft and neutral handoff contracts containing caller-authored candidate provenance, the exact detailed evidence packet, a replayable immutable selector and durable local locator, packet digest, export-time authorization evidence that transfers no authority, and fixed host-owned not-decided applicability, compliance, tailoring, baseline, and approval states.

Write a deterministic closed directory containing the handoff JSON, a no-script source-first HTML reader, and a manifest that binds both files; construct and validate it in a sibling temporary directory, reserve the target without overwrite, activate the manifest last after final reauthorization, and clean owned partial output on failure.

Render the selected source language separately from governing context, exact citations and spans, relationships, derivation and review status, coverage dimensions, interpretation limits, and unresolved evidence issues; escape all source-controlled text and block scripts, forms, frames, plugins, navigation, and network access with a restrictive content policy.

Validate the complete bundle by exact file set, safe canonical paths, regular-file and no-link checks, bytes and digests, handoff shape and packet digest, selector and package identities, fixed host-owned decision states, and byte-for-byte deterministic HTML rerendering.

Reject unauthorized or revoked access, selector mismatch, malformed or unprovenanced candidate drafts, caller-selected evidence references or decision states, compact or truncated evidence, existing output, path or link hazards, extra or changed files, changed packet digests, false applicability or approval states, and source text attempting HTML or instruction injection without leaving a published partial artifact.

Prove with the fictional pack that one export carries the selected clause and required governing note, validates against both machine contracts, is byte-identical across repeated exports, opens without a model or network, and remains an evidence candidate rather than a requirement, test plan, applicability decision, or approval.

tasks.title: Deterministic release SBOM and attestable evidence
acceptance: Generate a deterministic closed release-evidence directory for the exact twice-built core wheel and actual synthetic starter archive, containing a standards-based SBOM, a subject manifest, and a release-evidence statement bound to the wheel provenance, source revision, dependency lock, and starter manifest.

Distinguish deterministic unsigned local evidence from CI-issued signed attestations; record the expected repository, workflow, protected branch, predicate type, and signer only as verification policy, never as a claim that a local artifact is signed.

Validate every subject by bytes and SHA-256, revalidate the wheel provenance and extracted starter bundle, recompute the source inventory and lock digest, require a clean source revision for release attestation, and reject mismatched, missing, extra, linked, or mutated evidence files.

Produce byte-identical local evidence from identical inputs under a fixed source epoch, use canonical serialization and stable component identities, and validate the SBOM and release statement against closed machine contracts without network access.

On protected main-branch CI only, rebuild and exercise the actual release artifacts, retain the local evidence, and issue a GitHub artifact attestation pinned to an immutable action revision with least-privilege identity permissions; pull requests must perform all local validation without requesting an identity token.

Document online and pre-fetched offline verification as separate procedures, require both subject digest and trusted repository/workflow identity, and do not describe a retained attestation bundle as verified until the verification command succeeds.

Cover tampered wheel, provenance, starter, starter manifest, source inventory, lock, subject manifest, SBOM, release statement, dirty or absent source revision, false signed status, wrong verification identity, noncanonical paths, and partial output without publishing a valid-looking evidence set.

tasks.title: Resource-limited PDF parser process isolation
acceptance: Route every production pypdf path used by page-pack, corpus, and reviewed-structure compilation through one disposable child process per source PDF; the parent must not import or execute pypdf parsing code.

Use a closed versioned request/result protocol bound to the verified source bytes, parser versions, extraction mode, encryption policy, and fixed limit policy; return normalized page text as digest-inventoried regular files with the result activated last.

Enforce positive fixed source, page-count, decompressed-page, normalized-page, aggregate-output, result-metadata, process-memory, CPU, and wall-time bounds; never truncate parser output and never expose a disable or unlimited mode.

On POSIX, install address-space, CPU, file-size, and core limits before source parsing and kill the process group on timeout. On Windows, assign the blocked worker to a Job Object with memory, CPU, active-process, and kill-on-close limits before allowing it to parse; fail closed if required controls cannot be installed.

Accept only the exact regular-file result set with no links, safe canonical names, consecutive page ordinals, request/source/page digest equality, exact byte counts, valid UTF-8, declared normalization, and bounded metadata; treat any mismatch, crash, or missing activation result as a typed parser failure.

Stream accepted page files into existing sidecars while preserving established markers, offsets, quote digests, layout/simple extraction semantics, and deterministic final pack bytes; no complete pack or record may activate from partial worker output.

Make page extraction exceptions, timeout, resource termination, protocol failure, and output overrun fatal for the component and incomplete for the corpus; keep a genuinely empty text layer distinct and never count extraction failure as an ordinary page without text under a complete corpus status.

Cover deterministic replay, source change, timeout, crash, missing result, malformed result, extra or linked output, page-order/count/digest/UTF-8 mismatch, output limits, parser exception, Windows Job assignment, POSIX limit setup, and unchanged page/corpus/structure retrieval behavior across the supported CI matrix.

tasks.title: Executable generated-artifact contracts and schema lifecycle
acceptance: Keep every JSON Schema metaschema-valid and make schema validation an explicit non-core installation profile used by CI and contract tests.

Validate actual generated single-PDF and multi-component corpus extraction reports, structural annotations, records, distributions, response envelopes, diagnostics, benchmarks, release evidence, and handoffs against the exact matching schema rather than treating JSON parsing as contract validation.

Define a separate closed corpus extraction-report contract that matches the emitted composition, compiler, component, encryption, page, fidelity, and aggregate fields without weakening the single-PDF report contract.
Prove malformed schemas and representative generated packets fail validation, while retaining stricter runtime checks for files, canonical bytes, hashes, authorization, and cross-document invariants.

Document an explicit schema version policy and append-only change log: changed accepted shape or meaning requires a new instance version, unknown versions fail closed, and migrations cannot invent semantic or approval state.

tasks.title: Reviewed procedure-step ordering
acceptance: Add a versioned reviewed-structure annotation contract for an explicit sequence_after relationship without changing the accepted meaning of older annotation versions.
Accept one source-spanned resolved predecessor only between reviewed list-item siblings under the same explicit parent, with an earlier target ordinal and required retrieval context.
Compile, validate, install, and retrieve a two-step reviewed semantic procedure whose second step returns the first step and exact ordering relationship as required evidence.

Reject sequence ordering under older annotation versions, optional or unresolved predecessors, multiple immediate predecessors, non-list steps, cross-parent steps, and backward or cyclic ordinal claims.
Keep procedure ordering a reviewed source derivation rather than an applicability, compliance, test adequacy, or approval decision.

tasks.title: Offline model-ready prepared distribution
acceptance: Bundle the exact hash-locked Windows x64 CPython 3.12 MCP dependency closure as regular wheel files in the prepared archive and independently revalidate every byte through the closed distribution inventory, requirements digest, and canonical wheelhouse digest.

Install the core MCP extra only from the local wheelhouse with package indexes disabled, run dependency consistency checks, and fail readiness on a missing, duplicate, malformed, incomplete, or incompatible wheel set.

Provide a distribution-rooted MCP launcher that accepts no overrides, emits no bootstrap output on protocol stdout, and always supplies absolute database and object-store paths plus the fixed trusted local principal regardless of host working directory.

Before writing the ready marker, start the installed server over stdio, require the complete declared read-tool surface, and complete authorized document discovery and search against installed distribution state.
Document copy-paste Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and Cursor configuration using the absolute launcher path without expanding the read-only MCP surface or treating host configuration as authority.

tasks.title: Authorization-safe installed-document discovery
acceptance: Expose a seventh read-only list_documents operation through service, CLI, and principal-bound stdio MCP without exposing administrative or authorization selectors.
Return exact authorized installed-package identity, representation, immutable digest, record count, and declared coverage in deterministic keyset order with an exact matching count.
Normalize optional identifier prefixes without wildcard interpretation and bind signed continuations to operation, prefix, principal, authorization visibility, position, cumulative count, and expiry.

Return at most twenty deterministic replayable near-match candidates for exact alternate selectors, identifier prefixes, and matched document families; never use fuzzy, title, network, or model fallback.

Reauthorize returned packages and recheck authorization visibility immediately before returning inventory, exact resolution, ambiguity, or near-match results so absent and unauthorized resources remain indistinguishable.

Version the expanded seven-operation response and MCP contracts, retain query response 0.2 for historical consumers, and validate actual first and final inventory pages plus the closed near-match error envelope.

Prove empty-principal and revocation non-disclosure, stable prefix pagination, replayable hints, invalid limits, tampered cursors, prefix mismatch, and authorization-snapshot invalidation with networking disabled.
